00d468a3008a.name: Orbital Uplink
00d468a3008a.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one enemy unit. For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in one of your SA'CEA units makes a ranged attack against that unit, the target gets no benefit from cover against it.

0159e5116c4c.name: Coordinated Engagement
0159e5116c4c.plain: In your Shooting phase, before you pick a unit to shoot with: pick one enemy unit, plus two of your <SEPT> units that are within 18" of that enemy unit and visible to it. Until the phase ends, whenever a model in either of those <SEPT> units attacks, that attack may only target the chosen enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target), and its Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1.

041260ceaff1.name: Explodes (Devilfish)
041260ceaff1.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's DEVILFISH model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

057d97ed8ac3.name: Crushing Strike
057d97ed8ac3.plain: After this model completes a charge move, choose an enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll a D6: a 4-5 deals D3 mortal wounds to that unit, and a 6 deals 3 mortal wounds to it.

05d512e56502.name: Photon Casters
05d512e56502.plain: Whenever this unit is chosen as a target of a charge, subtract 2 from the charge roll for that charge.

06d910ae56ef.name: Drone Dock
06d910ae56ef.plain: Each PIRANHA model in this unit starts the battle with two of this unit's DRONE models docked with it.

07ed7328a74f.name: Focused Fire
07ed7328a74f.plain: In your Shooting phase, when an attack by a T'AU SEPT model from your army causes an enemy model to lose any wounds: for the rest of the phase, attacks by your T'AU SEPT CORE models against that enemy model's unit add 1 to their wound rolls.

082ad65c5ac4.name: Master of the Killing Blow
082ad65c5ac4.plain: This WARLORD's attacks improve their AP by 3 on unmodified wound rolls of 6, and a model they are allocated to can't use rules to ignore the wounds it loses.

086171145c71.name: Repulsor Impact Field
086171145c71.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase, when one of your BATTLESUIT units is picked as the target of a charge: until the phase ends, any unit that declares a charge against that BATTLESUIT unit must subtract 2 from its charge rolls. This modifier doesn't stack with any other negative modifier to a unit's charge roll.

096a52e42678.name: Defensive Doctrines
096a52e42678.plain: If a model with this tenet was charged this turn, melee attacks with AP -1 or AP -2 that are allocated to it have AP 0 instead.

0a23e792dcb4.name: Bodyguard Contingent
0a23e792dcb4.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each <SEPT> COMMANDER unit in a Detachment lets you add one <SEPT> CRISIS BODYGUARDS unit to that Detachment without using up a Battlefield Role slot.

0b3a987fd672.name: Play Their Part
0b3a987fd672.plain: For objective control, BATTLESUIT models with this tenet count as 3 models each if their Wounds characteristic is 9 or less, or 5 models if it is 10 or more.

0b3c31659d87.name: Set-up (Shieldline)
0b3c31659d87.plain: If this unit includes a Tidewall Defence Platform, then when the unit is first placed on the battlefield, the platform must go within 1" of the unit's Tidewall Shieldline. You may place TIDEWALL terrain features within 3" of other friendly TIDEWALL terrain features.

0bb12dad4b4f.name: Terrain Feature (Shieldline)
0bb12dad4b4f.plain: Once it has been set up, this unit's Tidewall Shieldline counts as a Building terrain feature.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

0c9de66ccf21.name: Pech’ra
0c9de66ccf21.plain: Targets of ranged attacks made by models in the bearer's unit don't get the benefits of cover against those attacks.

0ca689062dea.name: Overdrive Power Systems
0ca689062dea.plain: COMMANDER model only: pick up to two of the bearer's ranged weapons; its ranged attacks with them against units within half range add 1 to the wound roll.

0d3dc8f3ef63.name: Bounty Hunters
0d3dc8f3ef63.plain: At the start of the first battle round, pick one enemy unit as this unit's bounty. Models in this unit can re-roll the hit roll for any attack they make against that bounty.

11d98b712cf9.name: Pulse Onslaught
11d98b712cf9.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your FIRE WARRIOR TEAM units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a CORE model in that unit attacks with a pulse weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

1367a21ce92b.name: Terrain Feature (Defence Platform)
1367a21ce92b.plain: Once it has been set up, this unit's Tidewall Defence Platform, if it has one, counts as a Building terrain feature.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

1370bed49ef9.name: Recon Sweep
1370bed49ef9.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your PATHFINDER TEAM units successfully completes the Fire Markerlights action: add 1 to each roll you make to see whether an enemy unit gains a Markerlight token from that action. Your PATHFINDER TEAM unit can also make a Normal Move.

13a881cdcff2.name: Hero of the Empire
13a881cdcff2.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, you must choose this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model as your WARLORD. If several models in your army have a rule like this, one of them must be your WARLORD.

1477c07c6497.name: Unifying Influence
1477c07c6497.plain:
This WARLORD gains two auras:
- your non-CHARACTER DAL'YTH or T'AU AUXILIARY units within 6" of it add 1 to their models' Leadership (Diplomatic Excellence).
- the Markerlights rule treats your T'AU AUXILIARY units within 6" of it as if they didn't have the T'AU AUXILIARY keyword (Integrated Command Structure).

waive.93: page reference (pg 93) to where the Markerlights rules are printed; not part of the rule

150cbdbc255c.name: Calm Under Pressure
150cbdbc255c.plain: When a model with this tenet shoots an Assault weapon at a unit within 12", add 1 to that attack's Strength characteristic.

1572e6e2d4d8.name: Explodes (Ghostkeel)
1572e6e2d4d8.plain: Roll one D6 when this unit's GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT model is destroyed, before you remove it from play. On a 6, it explodes, inflicting D3 mortal wounds on each unit within 6".

1605f30d0d8c.name: Baggage harness
1605f30d0d8c.plain: The bearer gets the Baggage Harness (Aura) ability: while one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this model, whenever a model in that unit shoots a ranged attack, each unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit.

1655a4bea529.name: Gravity Wave Projector
1655a4bea529.plain: Any unit that declares a charge against this unit must subtract 2 from its charge rolls.

16c8091f1dfa.name: 1. Precision of the Hunter
16c8091f1dfa.plain: For every attack this WARLORD makes, you can re-roll the hit roll, the wound roll, or both.

16e647a3095c.name: Drone Dock (Sun Shark)
16e647a3095c.plain: At the start of the battle, this unit's INTERCEPTOR DRONE models are docked with its SUN SHARK BOMBER model.

173f6f43d995.name: Counterfire Defence System
173f6f43d995.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an attack is allocated to one of your COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEM models: that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 1. Cost: 2CP if that model's Wounds characteristic is 14 or more, otherwise 1CP.

18d32968df43.name: Paradox of Duality
18d32968df43.plain: Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. Subtract 1 from the wound roll of every attack made against this unit.

192fcdf5e7bf.name: Explodes (Sky Ray)
192fcdf5e7bf.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

19ba60252552.name: Drop Zone Clear
19ba60252552.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your FARSIGHT ENCLAVES BATTLESUITS units arrives on the battlefield via the Manta Strike ability or the Homing Beacon action: for the rest of the turn, ranged attacks by BATTLESUIT models in that unit may re-roll the hit roll and may re-roll the wound roll. Cost: 3CP if the unit includes 4 or more BATTLESUIT models, otherwise 2CP.

19f28102e33f.name: Dynamic Offensive
19f28102e33f.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your CRISIS BATTLESUIT units is picked to move. Until the end of the turn: whenever that unit Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, its models add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of that phase. Also, its models don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn in which their unit Advanced.

1a0b09217843.name: Leadership Caste
1a0b09217843.plain: You can add this unit to any T'AU EMPIRE Detachment other than a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES Detachment. Doing so doesn't stop that Detachment counting as a Sept Detachment, and doesn't stop your other units getting their Sept Tenet. This unit itself only gets a Sept Tenet if every <SEPT> unit in your army (ignoring SUPREME COMMANDER units) is from T'AU SEPT.

1bb6aa128bf6.name: Nova Reactor (R'varna)
1bb6aa128bf6.plain:
In your Command phase, you may activate this model's Nova Reactor. Doing so deals 1 mortal wound to this model; then choose one effect below. The chosen effect lasts until your next Command phase starts:
- It gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
- You may use the Nova profile of its weapons.
- During each Fight phase, roll a D6 per enemy unit within 6" of it; on a 4+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

1bd7171d7c2d.name: Serene Unifier (Ethereal)
1bd7171d7c2d.plain: This model knows 2 invocations from the Invocations of the Ethereals. During your Command phase, provided this model is on the battlefield, it may intone 1 of the invocations it knows, as long as no friendly model has already inspired that invocation this turn. Roll one D6; if the result is 3+, that intoned invocation counts as inspiring, and its effect applies until your next Command phase starts.

waive.76: page reference (pg 76) to where the invocations are printed; not part of the rule

1cb855cc3b37.name: 4. Through Boldness, Victory
1cb855cc3b37.plain: In your Command phase, pick a friendly <SEPT> CORE unit within 9" of this WARLORD: its CORE models' ranged attacks wound automatically on unmodified 6s to hit. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

1cebf5d34b0e.name: Docked Drone
1cebf5d34b0e.plain: While this model is docked with another model: any weapons it has count as being equipped on the model it is docked with instead; attacks can't be allocated to it, and it doesn't count as a model on the battlefield for any rule; and if the model it's docked with is destroyed, this DRONE model is destroyed too.

1dabdac87397.name: Strike and Fade
1dabdac87397.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase: pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE JET PACK units. It can shoot, and afterwards it can make a Normal Move of up to 6". It can't shoot again this phase. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models (not counting DRONE models), otherwise 2CP.

1ef601624eac.name: Ion Rifle (Overcharge)
1ef601624eac.plain: If any attack with this profile gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon.

1f09b6febf59.name: Sensory Negation Countermeasures
1f09b6febf59.plain: Once per battle, when the Fight phase starts, the bearer can make attacks by one enemy unit within Engagement Range of its unit subtract 1 from the hit roll. Doing so uses this Prototype System, and the penalty lasts until the end of the next turn. Only a COMMANDER or CRISIS model can have it.

1f8701d68829.name: Wisest of Their Kind (Aura)
1f8701d68829.plain: Aura: models in your KROOT units can use this model's Leadership characteristic in place of their own while their unit is within 6" of this model.

1fc6904cd9a5.name: Stratagem: Promising Pupil
1fc6904cd9a5.plain: Before the battle, while mustering, if your WARLORD has the T'AU EMPIRE keyword, give one of your T'AU EMPIRE CHARACTER models a Warlord Trait it can have. That model counts as your Warlord for that Warlord Trait only. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll randomly), and this Stratagem can't give a model 2 Warlord Traits. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

20aac66831c4.name: Grav-Inhibitor Field
20aac66831c4.plain:
The bearer:
- makes enemy units in its Engagement Range at the start of the Fight phase ineligible to fight that phase until all your eligible units have fought.
- has 1 subtracted from the hit roll of each melee attack made against it.

211e994c2491.name: Master of War (Aura) (Coldstar)
211e994c2491.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's COLDSTAR BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in this unit makes an attack.

2224f5ebe17e.name: Disengagement Protocols
2224f5ebe17e.plain: When an INFANTRY unit with this tenet is chosen to Fall Back, roll one D6 to try to deal mortal wounds to one enemy unit within its Engagement Range. On a 2-5, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

2233606a1d67.name: Supremacy Railgun
2233606a1d67.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target also suffers D3 mortal wounds on top of any other damage.

2347c93f2c9e.name: Target Sighted
2347c93f2c9e.plain: In your Command phase, choose a <SEPT> FIRE WARRIOR TEAM unit from your army that is within 9" of this unit's CADRE FIREBLADE model. Until your next Command phase starts, CORE models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their ranged attacks.

25714cb1e6ba.name: Hardened Armour
25714cb1e6ba.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to this unit's ENFORCER BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (minimum 1).

25d8437e795c.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
25d8437e795c.plain: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save, and once per turn, the first time it fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

27734539cb1c.name: Mobile Defences (Action)
27734539cb1c.plain:
Units in your army can do this action.
Mobile Defences (Action): one of your units embarked inside a TIDEWALL TRANSPORT may begin this action at the start of your Movement phase, even though units embarked within TRANSPORTS can't normally do actions. It finishes at the end of that phase. On a successful completion, that TIDEWALL SHIELDLINE may make a Normal Move, treating it as having a Move characteristic of 8" and the FLY keyword.

286b5c92cc56.name: Semi-automatic Grenade Launcher (EMP Grenade)
286b5c92cc56.plain: When an attack from this weapon scores a hit against a VEHICLE unit (other than a TITANIC unit) whose profile changes as it loses wounds, treat that unit as having half its remaining wounds when deciding which characteristics it uses. This lasts until the start of your next Shooting phase.

293edf61b6cf.name: Reliable Weaponry
293edf61b6cf.plain: Whenever a unit with this tenet is chosen to shoot, you can re-roll one of its wound rolls for those attacks.

296b843f6d89.name: Limited Parameters
296b843f6d89.plain: If every model in this unit is a DRONE model, the unit can't perform any action other than the Fire Markerlights action. It also loses Objective Secured if it has that ability, and it can't gain Objective Secured by any means.

waive.93: page reference (page 93) to where the Fire Markerlights action is printed; not part of the rule

2a706984f8bf.name: Grenade Belt
2a706984f8bf.plain: Blast. The bearer can shoot this weapon only once per battle.

2b806bf69d7a.name: Ka'chak'tarr
2b806bf69d7a.plain: You can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule when picking targets for this weapon. Each unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with it also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

2cd232be4eb7.name: Crushing Feet
2cd232be4eb7.plain: For every attack with this weapon, make 3 hit rolls rather than 1. Treat each of those hit rolls as its own separate attack.

2d54b542dadb.name: Stealth Field Generator
2d54b542dadb.plain: A model can only pick this unit as a target for ranged attacks if this unit is the closest eligible target to it, or if that model is within 18" of this unit.

2dc163ab0473.name: Master of War (Aura) (Shadowsun)
2dc163ab0473.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in this unit makes an attack.

2e434d5f857a.name: Stratagem: Emergency Dispensation
2e434d5f857a.plain: Before the battle, while mustering, if your WARLORD has the T'AU EMPIRE keyword, give one of your T'AU EMPIRE CHARACTER models a Relic it can have. Every Relic in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't give a model 2 Relics. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

2eaede62f619.name: Hover Drone
2eaede62f619.plain: During your Command phase this model may choose to hover. If so, until your next Command phase starts, it has a Move characteristic of 15" and loses its Airborne and Hard to Hit abilities.

2f4a07c5e5ed.name: Stabilised Optics
2f4a07c5e5ed.plain: The bearer ignores the hit roll penalties for firing Heavy weapons in a turn its unit moved, and at targets within Engagement Range of its unit.

30ef75ba67b9.name: Airborne
30ef75ba67b9.plain: This model can't declare a charge, and only a unit that can FLY can choose it as a charge target. It can only fight if it is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Only enemy units that can FLY can make melee attacks against it.

3102983c0995.name: Master of War (Aura) (Farsight)
3102983c0995.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's COMMANDER FARSIGHT model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in this unit makes an attack.

318e0afcf44d.name: Camouflage Fields
318e0afcf44d.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against this unit. Also, if a model in this unit has the benefits of cover when a ranged attack is allocated to it, add a further 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

32a87a0fe700.name: Drop Threat Acquisition
32a87a0fe700.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your BATTLESUITS units arrives on the battlefield via the Manta Strike ability or the Homing Beacon action: for the rest of the turn, ranged attacks by BATTLESUIT models in that unit may re-roll the hit roll. Cost: 3CP if the unit includes 4 or more BATTLESUIT models, otherwise 2CP.

33cec94f272b.name: Hover Tank
33cec94f272b.plain: Always measure distances to and from the hull of this unit's HAMMERHEAD model.

3479f21fa141.name: Frequency Lock
3479f21fa141.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your T'AU EMPIRE models is chosen to shoot: for the rest of the phase, every attack it makes with a destroyer missile, seeker missile or seeker missile rack adds 1 to its wound roll, and can target a unit that has one or more Markerlight tokens even if that unit isn't visible to the firing model.

348fbc5fa90f.name: Multi-function Surveyor
348fbc5fa90f.plain: In your Command phase, choose one protocol for this unit to perform. Repair Protocol: pick one of your <SEPT> BATTLESUIT models within 3" of this unit for it to repair; that BATTLESUIT model regains up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn. Surveillance Protocol: choose one enemy unit within 12" of this unit; it doesn't get the benefits of Light Cover until the turn ends.

35b869227552.name: Destroyer Missile
35b869227552.plain: Each destroyer missile the bearer has can only be fired once per battle. Whenever the bearer is picked to shoot, it can fire no more than two of its destroyer missiles.

37d05d209b3f.name: Tactical Acumen
37d05d209b3f.plain: In your Command phase, you may choose one FARSIGHT ENCLAVES CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this model. For the rest of the turn: that unit can still shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back; and for each ranged attack a CORE model in that unit makes, you can ignore any or all hit roll modifiers.

37d4227f1d0b.name: Advanced Targeting System
37d4227f1d0b.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 on the bearer's ranged attacks automatically wounds the target.

38001b9cfbae.name: High-altitude Manoeuvres
38001b9cfbae.plain: Once per battle, when your Movement phase starts, you may lift this unit off the battlefield. If you do, during that phase's Reinforcements step, either place it back on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from all enemy models, or, if the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rule, put it into Strategic Reserves.

3875460fd285.name: Airborne
3875460fd285.plain: This unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model can't declare a charge, and only a unit that can FLY can choose it as a charge target. It can only fight if it is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Only enemy units that can FLY can make melee attacks against it.

389c85fb5c9b.name: Stealthy Hunter
389c85fb5c9b.plain: When a ranged attack is allocated to this model while it has the benefits of cover, add a further 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

3cebd380f7ec.name: Homing Beacon
3cebd380f7ec.plain:
Units with a homing beacon can perform the action below, which lets you bring one of your <SEPT> CRISIS CORE units from a Manta Hold onto the battlefield.
Homing Beacon (Action): any number of your units with homing beacons may begin this action in your Command phase; it finishes at the start of the Reinforcements step in your next Movement phase. On completion, the acting unit discards its homing beacon, and you may set up on the battlefield one friendly <SEPT> CRISIS CORE unit that was in a Manta Hold (see Manta Strike), within 3" of that unit and more than 9" from all enemy models. This works even in the first battle round.

waive.92: page number of the Manta Strike reference

3d2561280f73.name: Battlesuits
3d2561280f73.plain: BATTLESUIT models in this unit may fire ranged weapons while their unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, but such attacks may only target enemy units within Engagement Range of those models. In that case they may target an enemy unit that other friendly units are also within Engagement Range of. A BATTLESUIT model with more than one ranged weapon can still choose targets outside its unit's Engagement Range, but that weapon's attacks are only made if all enemy units within Engagement Range of its unit are destroyed by the time you resolve them. In addition, while any enemy unit is within Engagement Range of a BATTLESUIT model's unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks with that model's Heavy weapons.

3d7cf60a6526.name: E-H Disruption Suite
3d7cf60a6526.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, the bearer can gain an aura that makes your opponent pay 1CP more for Stratagems on their units within 12" of it. To do so it uses this Prototype System, and the aura (E-H Disruption) lasts until your next Command phase starts. It applies whenever your opponent selects one of those units for a Stratagem, and whenever they use a Stratagem when one of those units is picked to shoot or fight. The extra cost applies only to that particular use; later uses cost the usual CP. GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT model only.

3df5a3cbd47d.name: Walking Battleship
3df5a3cbd47d.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move across other models (but not MONSTER or VEHICLE models) as if they weren't there.

3e07a6dcb6e1.name: Designated Tasking
3e07a6dcb6e1.plain: In your Command phase: choose a T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army that has no enemy units within Engagement Range and contains both DRONE models and models lacking the DRONE keyword. Divide it into two separate units: the DRONE models form one, and every model without the DRONE keyword forms the other. First, though, place any of those DRONE models that are docked with another model within 1" of that model; they are no longer docked with it.

3f3006ad8bc9.name: Tidewall Field
3f3006ad8bc9.plain: This TRANSPORT gets a 5+ invulnerable save.

3f8a7abc7bc5.name: Explodes (Riptide)
3f8a7abc7bc5.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's RIPTIDE model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

3f931973870a.name: Experimental Weaponry
3f931973870a.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your BORK'AN units is picked to shoot: pick one model in it and one weapon that model has. Until the phase ends, your opponent can't take invulnerable saving throws against attacks that model makes with that weapon.

3f9ff50daf56.name: On-board Sensors
3f9ff50daf56.plain:
At the start of your Shooting phase: pick one of your <SEPT> DEVILFISH models and one enemy unit within 24" of it and visible to it. Until the phase ends, that DEVILFISH model gets this ability:
Sensor Link (Aura): while one of your <SEPT> FIRE WARRIOR TEAM units is within 6" of this model, whenever a model in that unit makes a ranged attack against the chosen enemy unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

3fb0a5caa136.name: Sept Tenets
3fb0a5caa136.plain: If every unit in your army (other than T'AU AUXILIARY, SUPREME COMMANDER and UNALIGNED units) comes from the same sept, then every T'AU EMPIRE unit with this ability, and every model in those units, gets a Sept Tenet. Which Sept Tenet they get depends on their sept. If your sept has no Sept Tenet of its own, you must make up a new one for it using the custom Sept Tenet rules. Either way, record the Sept Tenets of all your Detachments on your army roster.

waive.62: page number of the custom Sept Tenet rules (pages 62-63)
waive.63: page number of the custom Sept Tenet rules ("pages 62-63")

4042b2269ffc.name: Master of War (Aura) (Crisis)
4042b2269ffc.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's CRISIS BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in this unit makes an attack.

405f9bbb4447.name: Rapid Retreat
405f9bbb4447.plain: When a unit with this tenet Falls Back, each of its models can move 3" further than normal.

41397ac95b21.name: Firing Positions
41397ac95b21.plain: In your Shooting phase, you can pick models embarked within this TRANSPORT to shoot, measuring range and checking visibility from any point on this Building. They can fire ranged weapons even when this Building is within Engagement Range of enemy units, just like a VEHICLE with the Big Guns Never Tire rule.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

422108c4b3af.name: Neuro-empathic Nullfier
422108c4b3af.plain: ETHEREAL model only: the bearer can try, once per battle in your Command phase, to stop a visible enemy unit within 18" of it from performing actions. To do so it uses this Relic: pick that unit and roll one D6. On a 2+, the unit can't perform actions until the start of the next Command phase, and if it is performing an action right now, that action fails immediately.

428007b6eeb3.name: 2. Pack Leader (Aura)
428007b6eeb3.plain: Aura: while one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this WARLORD, roll one extra D6 for its charge rolls and discard one of the dice.

42d37adf115e.name: XV02 Pilot Battlesuit
42d37adf115e.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one other T'AU SEPT CORE or T'AU SEPT HAMMERHEAD unit from your army within 6" of this unit's HAMMERHEAD model. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever a model in that unit makes an attack, treat the target as having a Markerlight token.

waive.93: page reference (pg 93) to where Markerlight tokens are explained; not part of the rule

4434ba215cfc.name: Piranha Fusion Blaster
4434ba215cfc.plain: Against a target within half range, attacks from this weapon have a Damage characteristic of D6+4.

448257b6b071.name: Strike Swiftly
448257b6b071.plain: At the start of the first battle round, each INFANTRY unit with this tenet that began wholly in your deployment zone may make a Normal Move of up to 6". This happens before the first turn begins, and the move can't end within 9" of the enemy deployment zone or of any enemy models.

44879162bdfa.name: Advanced EM Scrambler
44879162bdfa.plain:
Two effects:
- enemy units can't be set up as Reinforcements within 12" of the bearer.
- in your Command phase, pick one enemy unit within 6" of the bearer. Until your next Command phase starts, aura abilities of other units in your opponent's army can't affect it, unless those auras are psychic powers.

456e1299bfba.name: Wall of Mirrors
456e1299bfba.plain: At the end of your Movement phase: choose one of your STEALTH BATTLESUITS or GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT units wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and take it off the battlefield. During the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, you may place it back anywhere wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy models. If it still isn't on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

4610f5c67eef.name: Stabilising Anchors
4610f5c67eef.plain:
This model can do this action.
Deploy Anchors (Action): any number of your STORMSURGE models may begin this action at the start of your Movement phase; it finishes at the start of your next Shooting phase. If it completes successfully, then for the rest of that phase you may re-roll the hit roll for each ranged attack this model makes.

4995632fbf13.name: Leadership Caste (Aun'Shi)
4995632fbf13.plain: You can add this unit to any T'AU EMPIRE Detachment other than a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES Detachment. Doing so doesn't stop that Detachment counting as a Sept Detachment, and doesn't stop your other units getting their Sept Tenet. This unit itself only gets a Sept Tenet if every <SEPT> unit in your army (ignoring SUPREME COMMANDER units) is from VIOR'LA SEPT.

waive.55: page reference (pg 55) to where Sept Tenets are printed; not part of the rule

4a16c7f98f0d.name: Talisman of Arthas Moloch
4a16c7f98f0d.plain: The bearer adds 1 to its Deny the Witch tests and, in your opponent's Psychic phase, can try to deny one psychic power as though it were a PSYKER.

4a4e0527290b.name: Failure Is Not An Option (Aura)
4a4e0527290b.plain: Aura: your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units (except FARSIGHT ENCLAVES and T'AU AUXILIARY units) can borrow this model's Leadership characteristic in place of their own while they are within 6" of this unit's ETHEREAL model.

4b5ae71ac742.name: Reinforced Armour
4b5ae71ac742.plain: Subtract 1 from the Strength of ranged attacks made against VEHICLE or BATTLESUIT units with this tenet by weapons with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less.

4b5b6311411e.name: Explodes (6/2D6"/2D6)
4b5b6311411e.plain: Roll a D6 when this model is destroyed, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing 2D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 2D6".

4baa7b333bea.name: 3. Zephyr's Grace
4baa7b333bea.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units within 6" of this ETHEREAL: subtract 1 from the hit roll of ranged attacks against it. This only applies if the unit didn't Remain Stationary in your previous Movement phase. You can't pick a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES unit.

4dec80ba77df.name: Wide-Spectrum Scanners
4dec80ba77df.plain: At the end of your opponent's Reinforcements step, the bearer can shoot one enemy unit within 12" of it that arrived as Reinforcements this turn. It can do so only if it isn't within Engagement Range of any enemy units. It shoots as though it were your Shooting phase, but can target only a single such unit, and that unit must be an eligible target. Only a model with an early warning override can use this.

4f796710c1e6.name: Master of War (Aura) (Enforcer)
4f796710c1e6.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's ENFORCER BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in this unit makes an attack.

5071a3c44b70.name: Serene Unifier (Aun'Shi)
5071a3c44b70.plain: This model knows 3 invocations from the Invocations of the Ethereals. During your Command phase, provided this unit's Aun'Shi model is on the battlefield, it may intone as many as 2 of the invocations it knows, as long as no friendly model has already intoned them this turn. Roll one D6; if the result is 2+, that intoned invocation counts as inspiring, and its effect applies until your next Command phase starts.

waive.76: page reference (pg 76) to where the invocations are printed; not part of the rule

5084df5e0f26.name: Ambushing Predators
5084df5e0f26.plain: When the first battle round starts, models in this unit may move up to 7" as a Normal Move. They must finish that move more than 9" away from all enemy models.

508823461272.name: Master of War (Aura)
508823461272.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units is within 6" of this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in that unit makes an attack.

50c037c4df8a.name: Supersonic (Sun Shark)
50c037c4df8a.plain: When this unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model Advances, Falls Back or makes a Normal Move, first turn it on the spot by up to 90 degrees (the turn doesn't count toward how far it moves), then move it straight ahead. It can't pivot again after that first pivot.

519384e25c4a.name: Sa'cea Sept Tenet: Masters of Urban Warfare
519384e25c4a.plain:
Three effects:
- VEHICLE units with this tenet get the benefits of Dense Cover against ranged attacks from attackers more than 18" away.
- INFANTRY units with this tenet get the benefits of Dense Cover against ranged attacks from attackers more than 12" away.
- VEHICLE and BATTLESUIT models with this tenet ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons at enemy units within Engagement Range of them.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a reference, which the style guide says to leave out

52d89759f3d9.name: A Trap Well Laid
52d89759f3d9.plain:
In the Heroic Interventions step of your opponent's Charge phase: choose a KROOT unit from your army with no enemy units within Engagement Range of it. For the rest of the turn:
- Its models add 1 to their Attacks characteristic.
- It can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER.
- If an enemy unit is within 6" of it horizontally, it is eligible to perform a Heroic Intervention, and each of its models can move up to 6" when making that Heroic Intervention move. All other Heroic Intervention rules still apply.

5325f51f6496.name: Outflanking Harassers
5325f51f6496.plain: Instead of deploying this unit on the battlefield, you can place it behind enemy lines during deployment. In that case, during the Reinforcements step of any of your Movement phases, you can put it on the battlefield wholly within 6" of any battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy models.

53fdab5b8416.name: Hard to Hit (Sun Shark)
53fdab5b8416.plain: Ranged attacks that target this unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model subtract 1 from their hit rolls.

543562a90327.name: Baggage Harness (Aura)
543562a90327.plain: Aura: while one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this model, each unmodified hit roll of 6 on a ranged attack by a model in that unit scores 1 extra hit.

5508cc4fd7b1.name: Inspired to Greatness
5508cc4fd7b1.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE or T'AU AUXILIARY units (not FARSIGHT ENCLAVES units) within 6" of this unit's ETHEREAL model. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit can make ranged attacks while it is performing an action and the action won't fail because of it.

56b9121a6aaa.name: Artificial Helpers
56b9121a6aaa.plain: Ignore DRONE models when: using the Look Out, Sir rule; working out this unit's Starting Strength and whether it is below Half-strength; and working out this unit's Toughness if the unit also has models without the DRONE keyword.

56d8f0d593b2.name: Ohr'tu's Lantern
56d8f0d593b2.plain: Model with a markerlight only: each time it performs the Fire Markerlights action, roll 5 extra D6s; each 3+ gives the enemy unit one Markerlight token.

waive.93: page reference (pg 93) to where the Fire Markerlights action are printed; not part of the rule

5ac606f05549.name: Sworn Protectors
5ac606f05549.plain: If any CRISIS models in this unit are within 3" of one of your <SEPT> CHARACTER models (not VEHICLE or MONSTER models), that CHARACTER's unit can use the Look Out, Sir rule even when this unit has fewer than 3 models.

5ac637c02f89.name: The Grisly Feast
5ac637c02f89.plain: In the Fight phase, when an attack by a model in one of your KROOT units destroys an enemy unit: for the rest of the battle, whenever a model in that KROOT unit would lose a wound, roll a D6; on a 5+ the wound is not lost.

5b65ef1ba560.name: Stimm Injectors
5b65ef1ba560.plain: Once per battle, when the bearer fails a saving throw, it can use this Prototype System to try to avoid losing wounds until the turn ends. If it does, roll one D6 each time the bearer would lose a wound this turn: on a 4+, it doesn't lose that wound. Only a COMMANDER or CRISIS model can have this system.

5bfe0932d0a5.name: T'au Sept Tenet: Coordinated Fire Arcs
5bfe0932d0a5.plain:
Three effects:
- each time a unit with this tenet is chosen to shoot or fight, one hit roll or one wound roll for its attacks can be re-rolled.
- models with this tenet add 3" to the range of their aura abilities, to a maximum range of 12".
- models with this tenet add 3" to the range of each invocation they intone that isn't an aura, and of each ability with a stated range that they use in your Command phase (to a maximum range of 12").

5dbedbf6d9ed.name: Eclipse Shield Generator
5dbedbf6d9ed.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, and you add 1 to its armour saving throws.

5dfa24cca593.name: Tiger Shark (Transport)
5dfa24cca593.plain: This model can transport up to 14 <SEPT> TACTICAL DRONES models.

5e84cfcda9fb.name: Submunitions
5e84cfcda9fb.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your HAMMERHEAD models with a railgun is picked to shoot: rather than attacking with the railgun this phase, choose an enemy unit within 36" of the model and visible to it that isn't within Engagement Range of any of your units. Roll a D6 per model in that unit, adding 1 to each roll if the unit has 11 or more models. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on it, up to a maximum of 8 mortal wounds.

60dcc71983fe.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
60dcc71983fe.plain: You may get back Command points spent on T'au Empire Battle Tactic and Epic Deed Stratagems. While the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6 for each Command point you spend on a T'au Empire Stratagem of either kind: on a 3+, that point is refunded.

612e38e461cf.name: Twin heavy fusion cannon
612e38e461cf.plain: If the target of an attack from this weapon is within half range, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes D6+4.

619cc595d25b.name: Camouflage Experts
619cc595d25b.plain: INFANTRY units with this tenet that are entirely on or within a terrain feature get the benefits of Dense Cover against ranged attacks from over 12" away.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a reference, which the style guide says to leave out

61c321ae0f72.name: Novasurge Plasma Rifle
61c321ae0f72.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS model with at least one plasma rifle can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

63666d49716d.name: Target Uploaded
63666d49716d.plain: This unit can begin the Fire Markerlights action at the end of your Movement phase rather than at its start.

639b18b3c5d3.name: Drone Shield Generator
639b18b3c5d3.plain: Any model that has a shield generator has a 4+ invulnerable save.

6549570d557a.name: Hero of the Empire (Shadowsun)
6549570d557a.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, you must choose this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model as your WARLORD. If several models in your army have a rule like this, one of them must be your WARLORD.

67c3172b5166.name: The Kindled Blade
67c3172b5166.plain: CADRE FIREBLADE model only: in your Command phase, once per battle, the bearer can make nearby <SEPT> FIRE WARRIOR TEAM units pass Morale tests automatically. To do so it uses this Relic, gaining the Bonding Ritual aura until your next Command phase starts; the aura covers each of your <SEPT> FIRE WARRIOR TEAM units while that unit is within 6" of the bearer.

681ac29bb68a.name: Cloaked Insertion
681ac29bb68a.plain: Instead of deploying this unit on the battlefield, you can hold it cloaked in the sky during deployment. In that case, during the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, you can put it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

69161788426f.name: Serene Unifier (Aun'va)
69161788426f.plain: This unit's Aun'va model knows 3 invocations from the Invocations of the Ethereals. During your Command phase, if that Aun'va model is on the battlefield, it may intone as many as 2 of the invocations it knows, provided no friendly model has already intoned them this turn. Roll one D6; if the result is 2+, that intoned invocation counts as inspiring, and its effect applies until your next Command phase starts.

waive.76: page reference (pg 76) to where the invocations are printed; not part of the rule

69e7c07336ad.name: Explodes (Sun Shark)
69e7c07336ad.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

69f6622a9505.name: Cyclic Ion Blaster (Overcharge)
69f6622a9505.plain: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 made for an attack with this profile, the bearer's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

6a17f4d76d57.name: 1. Storm of Fire
6a17f4d76d57.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units within 6" of this ETHEREAL: it can make ranged attacks without its actions failing. You can't pick a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES unit.

6a96e3e81084.name: Neuroweb System Jammer
6a96e3e81084.plain: The bearer has the NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER keyword.

6aa9fea37095.name: 2. Through Unity, Devastation (Aura)
6aa9fea37095.plain: Aura: while one of your <SEPT> CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, its CORE models' ranged attacks improve their AP by 1 on unmodified wound rolls of 6.

6c4b10299253.name: Resonator Warheads
6c4b10299253.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS model with at least one missile pod can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

6c7a9ddba435.name: Nova Reactor (Riptide)
6c7a9ddba435.plain:
In your Command phase, this unit's RIPTIDE model may activate its Nova Reactor. To do so, roll 2D6: if the total exceeds the RIPTIDE model's remaining wounds, the reactor burns out and this ability is unusable for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick one reactor ability:
- Nova Shield: until your next Command phase starts, roll a D6 whenever this model would lose a wound; on a 5+ that wound isn't lost.
- Boost: during your next Charge phase, this unit may make a Normal Move of up to 2D6"; if it does so, it can't declare a charge that phase.
- Nova Charge: until your next Command phase starts, if this model has a heavy burst cannon, that weapon is Type Heavy 16; if not, both profiles of its ion accelerator are Type Heavy 8 instead.

6c9bdd243336.name: Stealth Field Technology
6c9bdd243336.plain: Against ranged attacks, this unit always counts as having the benefits of light cover.

6cdb2160be72.name: Master of War (Aura)
6cdb2160be72.plain: Aura: re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by CORE models in any of your <SEPT> CORE units while that unit is within 6" of this unit's COLDSTAR BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model.

6ce75fda1f05.name: Academy Luminary
6ce75fda1f05.plain: You may get back Command points spent on T'au Empire Strategic Ploy and Wargear Stratagems. While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, roll one D6 for each Command point you spend on a T'au Empire Stratagem of either kind: on a 3+, that point is refunded.

6dcb296d43dd.name: Threat Identification Protocol
6dcb296d43dd.plain: When this model makes ranged attacks, it can target only the nearest eligible unit.

6e490a756cdf.name: Markerlights
6e490a756cdf.plain:
Units in your army can do this action.
Fire Markerlights (Action): at the start of your Movement phase, one or more of your MARKERLIGHT units can begin this action; AIRCRAFT MARKERLIGHT units are allowed to do it. It finishes at the start of your next Shooting phase. On successful completion, for every markerlight carried by each model in the unit, choose one enemy unit within 36" of that model that it could target if its unit had been picked to shoot, then roll a D6: on a 3+, that enemy unit gets a Markerlight token.
A VEHICLE or DRONE unit doing Fire Markerlights can move without the action failing. If it moves, then until the end of the turn, any of its models that lack the VEHICLE or DRONE keyword and carry markerlights count as having no markerlights for the Fire Markerlights action.
Whenever a T'AU EMPIRE unit (other than a T'AU AUXILIARY unit) is picked to shoot:
- Its models add 1 to the hit roll of ranged attacks against a unit that has one or more Markerlight tokens.
- Once it has finished its attacks, take one Markerlight token off each enemy unit it targeted.
At the end of your Shooting phase, take all Markerlight tokens off enemy units.

6e7504af07ea.name: Pulse Accelerator
6e7504af07ea.plain: When a model in this unit attacks with a pulse weapon, that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

waive.130: page number of the pulse weapon reference

6f55be96aea6.name: Early Warning Override
6f55be96aea6.plain: When the bearer fires Overwatch, unmodified hit rolls of 5+ score hits instead of only 6s, and Fire Overwatch costs 1CP less (minimum 0CP) for its unit. This cost cut needs the bearer to be on the battlefield when its unit is picked to fire Overwatch, and it applies only to that one use of the Stratagem; later uses cost the usual CP.

6f933a238cd9.name: Hardened Warheads
6f933a238cd9.plain: Targets of ranged attacks made with missile weapons by models with this tenet don't get the benefits of cover against those attacks.

waive.130: page reference (pg 130) to where missile weapons are printed; not part of the rule

70b0768ee094.name: Master of War (Aura)
70b0768ee094.plain: Aura: while one of your FARSIGHT ENCLAVES CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a CORE model in that unit makes an attack.

70e173d7b82e.name: 4. Power of Tides
70e173d7b82e.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, pick one of your T'AU AUXILIARY units within 6" of this ETHEREAL: add 1 to the wound roll for every attack its models make.

71fe2e9d70df.name: Tactical Acumen (Crisis)
71fe2e9d70df.plain: In your Command phase, you may choose one <SEPT> CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this unit's CRISIS BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model. For the rest of the turn: that unit can still shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back; and for each ranged attack a CORE model in that unit makes, you can ignore any or all hit modifiers.

721218a80198.name: Drone Dock (Hammerhead)
721218a80198.plain: Any DRONE models in this unit start the game docked with this unit's HAMMERHEAD model.

72f39c066cbb.name: Wrecked
72f39c066cbb.plain: Roll a D6 when this Building is destroyed, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 6". On any other roll it is wrecked instead: it counts as destroyed for all rules purposes, but leave it on the battlefield. For the rest of the battle it is an Obstacle terrain feature with these terrain traits: Difficult Ground, Exposed Position and Unstable Position.

731415f38267.name: Inspirational Defiance (Aura)
731415f38267.plain: Aura: while one of your VIOR'LA CORE units is within 6" of this model, whenever an enemy unit declares a charge against it, that unit can Hold Steady or Set to Defend, as long as it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units.

73f30cf48876.name: Advanced Guardian Shield Generator
73f30cf48876.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. A model can only pick this unit as a target for ranged attacks if this unit is the closest eligible target to that model.

752da8e94cab.name: 5. Unifying Mantra (Aura)
752da8e94cab.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units within 6" of this ETHEREAL add 1 to Combat Attrition tests and can re-roll Morale tests. This doesn't apply to FARSIGHT ENCLAVES units.

7908db0ea54c.name: Remora Seeker Missile
7908db0ea54c.plain: You can only use this weapon once per battle.

7919a6b9130a.name: Positional Relay
7919a6b9130a.plain: Once per battle round, the bearer can let one of your <SEPT> units arriving from Strategic Reserves set up wherever it could if the battle round were 1 higher. If it does, that unit must be set up within 6" of the bearer.

79b9939333b5.name: Blacklight Markers
79b9939333b5.plain: When this model performs the Fire Markerlights action, it can pick an eligible enemy unit within 48" of it rather than within 36".

7ade08481bbf.name: Voracious Predators
7ade08481bbf.plain: This unit can re-roll its Advance rolls and charge rolls.

7ae0daf1ce6d.name: Counterfire Defence System
7ae0daf1ce6d.plain: The bearer has the COUNTERFIRE DEFENCE SYSTEM keyword.

7b0b880a776e.name: DW-02 Advanced Burst Cannon
7b0b880a776e.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS model with at least one burst cannon can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

7b321f22004a.name: Terrain Feature (Droneport)
7b321f22004a.plain: Once set up, this unit's Tidewall Droneport counts as a Building terrain feature.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

7cba91e1731c.name: Blocking Tactics
7cba91e1731c.plain: When a CORE INFANTRY unit with this tenet makes a charge move, its CORE models have the Objective Secured ability until the start of your next Charge phase. Any such model that already has that ability counts as one additional model when working out control of an objective marker.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a reference, which the style guide says to leave out

7d5332bd95c0.name: Embodiments of the Empire
7d5332bd95c0.plain: This model can't be from the FARSIGHT ENCLAVES Sept.

7d9c1cb8d8b2.name: Tactical Acumen
7d9c1cb8d8b2.plain: In your Command phase, you may choose one <SEPT> CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this unit's CRISIS BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model. For the rest of the turn: that unit can still shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back; and for each ranged attack a CORE model in that unit makes, you can ignore any or all hit roll modifiers.

7f2458504a56.name: 3. A Ghost Walks Among Us
7f2458504a56.plain: Attacks against this WARLORD subtract 1 from the hit roll, and when it Advances it skips the Advance roll and adds 6" to its Move until the end of the phase.

7f5f4b73bb2d.name: Adherents to the Teachings
7f5f4b73bb2d.plain: Models with this tenet add 3" (to a maximum of 12") to the range of their auras, non-aura invocations and abilities with a range used in your Command phase.

8040d0256f30.name: Docked Drones
8040d0256f30.plain: While this model is docked with another model: any weapons it has count as being equipped on the model it is docked with instead; attacks can't be allocated to it, and it doesn't count as a model on the battlefield for any rule; and if the model it's docked with is destroyed, this DRONE model is destroyed too.

80ca1787b095.name: Drone Uplink
80ca1787b095.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose a SNIPER DRONE unit within 6" of this unit's FIRESIGHT MARKSMAN model. The following apply until your next Command phase starts: SNIPER DRONE models in that unit have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 3+; when choosing targets for attacks by SNIPER DRONE models in that unit, you can ignore the Look Out, Sir rule; and for attacks by SNIPER DRONE models in that unit, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target on top of normal damage.

8287ca144fd2.name: Branched Nova Charge
8287ca144fd2.plain: In your Command phase, when the Nova Reactor ability of a RIPTIDE BATTLESUIT model from your army burns out: it doesn't burn out after all, and you can pick one of its reactor abilities. This Stratagem can stop a given model's reactor burning out no more than once per battle.

82cd41d5a0e9.name: Ion Cannon (Overcharge)
82cd41d5a0e9.plain: Blast. For each unmodified hit roll of 1 made for an attack with this profile, the bearer's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon.

82d2a105e90b.name: Defender of the Greater Good
82d2a105e90b.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE or T'AU EMPIRE CHARACTER units within 6" of this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model. Until your next Command phase starts, CORE or CHARACTER models in that unit can re-roll the hit roll for each attack they make.

82eb5ba6130a.name: Threat Identification Protocols
82eb5ba6130a.plain: In the Shooting phase, Gun Drones may only target the closest visible enemy unit. If two units are tied for closest, you pick which one is targeted.

833ae8766be7.name: Drone Dock (Piranhas)
833ae8766be7.plain: Each PIRAHNA model in this unit starts the battle with two of this unit's DRONE models docked with it.

83a7beafad4f.name: Manta Strike
83a7beafad4f.plain: When you deploy, if all models in this unit have this ability, you can put the unit in a Manta hold instead of on the battlefield. A unit placed this way can arrive in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases: set it up anywhere on the battlefield over 9" from every enemy model.

845252b1b32b.name: Loyal to the End
845252b1b32b.plain: Models with this tenet add 1 to their Leadership characteristic, and you can re-roll Morale tests taken for units with this tenet.

859b8b88649b.name: Pulse Bombs
859b8b88649b.plain: In your Movement phase, once per turn, after this unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model has finished moving: if it is still on the battlefield, you can choose one unit it moved over. For that unit, roll six D6 per VEHICLE or MONSTER model and one D6 per other model, up to ten D6 in total. Every 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the unit. (Arks of Omen dataslate, January 2023 update.)

886fbcdce3b1.name: DS8 Support Turret
886fbcdce3b1.plain: These rules apply to Support Turret models: they are ignored when working out a unit's Starting Strength and whether it is at Half-strength; their destruction is ignored for Morale tests; they don't take up space in a TRANSPORT; and in your Movement phase, whenever this unit is selected to move and has a Support Turret model on the battlefield, you can take that model off the battlefield (this doesn't count as it being destroyed).

88b771262e61.name: Railgun
88b771262e61.plain: Invulnerable saves can't be taken against attacks made with this weapon. Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target suffers 3 mortal wounds on top of any other damage.

890171c99a51.name: Novasurge Plasma Rifle
890171c99a51.plain: Invulnerable saves can't be taken against attacks made with this weapon.

89316500c187.name: Explodes
89316500c187.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

8a532d29a633.name: Keywords
8a532d29a633.plain: Drone models don't take on the keywords of any unit they belong to (Tactical Drones are the exception). When it comes to terrain features, DRONE models are treated as having the INFANTRY keyword.

8a81fb507a28.name: Photon Grenades
8a81fb507a28.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase, when one of your PHOTON GRENADES units is chosen as the target of a charge declared by an enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit): until the end of the turn, the charging enemy unit subtracts 2 from its charge rolls, and its models subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack they make. This charge roll modifier doesn't stack with any other negative modifier to a unit's charge roll.

8a9a80d38241.name: Dominator Fragmentation Launcher
8a9a80d38241.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS with at least one airbursting fragmentation projector can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

8ab458a74093.name: High Intensity Markerlights
8ab458a74093.plain: Whenever a model in this unit does the Fire Markerlights action, roll two extra D6.

8b714d2115c6.name: Fighting Retreat (Aura)
8b714d2115c6.plain: Aura: while one of your T'AU SEPT CORE units (other than BATTLESUIT units) is within 6" of this model, it can shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

8ba4ddb5d7fe.name: Bork'an Sept Tenet: Superior Craftsmanship
8ba4ddb5d7fe.plain:
Two effects:
- models with this tenet add 4" to the Range characteristic of their ranged weapons.
- when a ranged attack is made against a VEHICLE or BATTLESUIT unit with this tenet using a weapon with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, subtract 1 from that attack's Strength.

8c3fadc29e9d.name: Vior'la Sept Tenet: Strike Fast
8c3fadc29e9d.plain:
Two effects:
- at the start of your first turn, your units wholly within your deployment zone add 2" to their models' Move characteristic until that turn ends.
- you can re-roll Advance rolls and charge rolls for units with this tenet.

8c8f6b0db5f9.name: Promising Pupil
8c8f6b0db5f9.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the T'AU EMPIRE keyword: choose one T'AU EMPIRE CHARACTER model in your army and give it one Warlord Trait (it must be one that model is allowed). That model counts as your Warlord only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army has to be different (re-roll duplicates if generating randomly), and this Stratagem can't give a model a second Warlord Trait. You can use this Stratagem only once, except in a Strike Force battle (up to twice) or an Onslaught battle (up to three times).

8ca9a9c85c64.name: Terrain Feature
8ca9a9c85c64.plain: Once set up, this unit's Tidewall Droneport counts as a Building terrain feature.

8d97dab1133d.name: Fusion Collider
8d97dab1133d.plain: If an attack from this weapon targets an enemy unit within half range, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes D6+2.

8e6a47a6cce2.name: XV22 Stalker Battlesuit
8e6a47a6cce2.plain: The COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model in this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save.

8ed895724a72.name: 6. Wisdom of the Guides
8ed895724a72.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, you receive 1 Command point.

8f542c5d7784.name: 1. Master of the Hunt (Aura)
8f542c5d7784.plain: Aura: while one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this WARLORD, its models' ranged attacks against units within 12" deny the target the benefits of cover.

8fa749541e0c.name: Explodes (Hammerhead)
8fa749541e0c.plain: Roll one D6 when this unit's HAMMERHEAD model is destroyed, before you remove it from play. On a 6, it explodes, inflicting D6 mortal wounds on each unit within 6".

90af97b7cdf8.name: Markerlight
90af97b7cdf8.plain: The model with this ability has the MARKERLIGHT keyword.

9188cb7a6215.name: Saviour Protocols
9188cb7a6215.plain: Whenever an attack made against one of your <SEPT> INFANTRY or <SEPT> BATTLESUIT units wounds it while it is within 3" of one of your <SEPT> DRONES units, you may roll one D6. On a 2+, the attack sequence ends and that DRONES unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

920431c239aa.name: Defenders of the Cause
920431c239aa.plain: Roll one D6 whenever a model with this tenet (other than a DRONE model) would lose a wound to a mortal wound: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

923da724e59b.name: Airborne (Sun Shark)
923da724e59b.plain: This unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model can't declare a charge, and only a unit that can FLY can choose it as a charge target. It can only fight if it is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit that can FLY, and its melee attacks can only target units that can FLY. Only enemy units that can FLY can make melee attacks against it.

94a53807def4.name: Drone Control Systems
94a53807def4.plain:
During your Command phase, if one or more friendly <SEPT> units are embarked inside this TRANSPORT, you can choose one DRONES unit within 6" of the TRANSPORT. Until your next Command phase begins:
- That unit's DRONE models have a Ballistic Skill of 4+.
- That unit's GUN DRONE models lose the Drone Identification Protocol ability.

95bb766f3f45.name: Explodes
95bb766f3f45.plain: Whenever a PIRANHA model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing 1 mortal wound to each unit within 3".

95f50b9d85d1.name: Tri-axis Ion Cannon (Overcharge)
95f50b9d85d1.plain: Blast. Whenever the bearer fires this profile, if any of its attacks get an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds once it has finished shooting this weapon.

98933130799d.name: Point-blank Volley
98933130799d.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase: pick one of your FIRE WARRIOR TEAM units that is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit. Until the phase ends, every pulse rifle, pulse carbine and pulse blaster its models carry has the Type Pistol 2 instead.

99a30fc05ccf.name: Nova Reactor
99a30fc05ccf.plain:
In your Command phase, you may activate this model's Nova Reactor. Doing so deals 1 mortal wound to this model; then choose one effect below. The chosen effect lasts until your next Command phase starts:
- It gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
- You may use the Nova profile of its weapons.
- Add 12" to its Move characteristic, and it can shoot in a turn in which it Falls Back.

9c320699fd10.name: Command-link
9c320699fd10.plain: The ranges of this unit's aura abilities are increased by 3" (to a maximum of 12"). Also, whenever a model in this unit uses an ability other than an aura ability in your Command phase, that ability's range is increased by 3".

9cb5a2aa37e5.name: For the Greater Good
9cb5a2aa37e5.plain: Whenever an enemy unit declares a charge against this unit, it can fire Overwatch before the charge roll. In addition, if an enemy unit declares a charge against this unit, each friendly unit with this ability within 6" of this unit can fire Overwatch before the charge roll; any friendly unit that does so can't fire Overwatch again that phase. Designer's note: units with this ability don't need the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to fire Overwatch this way.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in the designer's note; not part of the rule

9d6399bafc7f.name: Dynamic Mirror Field
9d6399bafc7f.plain: The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save, and ranged attacks can target it only if it is the firing model's closest target or that model is within 12" of it.

9fa46f3a94a2.name: Shocking Firestorm
9fa46f3a94a2.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your <SEPT> units is picked to shoot: choose an enemy unit within 18" of it. For the rest of the phase, each model in that enemy unit destroyed by an attack from a model in your <SEPT> unit counts as two destroyed models for Morale tests this turn.

a00ee1db5694.name: Gunship Ace
a00ee1db5694.plain: Add 1 to the wound roll of each ranged attack this unit's HAMMERHEAD model makes against a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.

a032c1ddf188.name: Fire Saturation
a032c1ddf188.plain: Ranged attacks made with burst weapons by models with this tenet add 1 to their hit roll when they target a unit within 12".

waive.130: page reference (pg 130) to where burst weapons are printed; not part of the rule

a03e458dbc9c.name: Plunge from the Sky
a03e458dbc9c.plain: Instead of deploying this unit on the battlefield, you can hold it high in the sky during deployment. In that case, during the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, you can put it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

a041caff95d7.name: Heavy rail cannon array
a041caff95d7.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target also suffers 3 mortal wounds on top of any other damage.

a155498f3e3b.name: Wisdom of the Many
a155498f3e3b.plain: At the start of any of your phases except your Command phase: choose an ETHEREAL unit from your army that hasn't intoned an invocation this turn. That model may intone one invocation that no friendly model has intoned yet this turn. It is automatically inspiring (no roll needed) and lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

a1ab13275075.name: Hover Tank (Hammerhead)
a1ab13275075.plain: For this unit's VEHICLE model, measure distances to and from its hull or its base, whichever is closer.

a2d5f1f6a686.name: Drone Dock
a2d5f1f6a686.plain: Any DRONE models in this unit start the battle docked with this unit's DEVILFISH model.

a36b399423b6.name: Heavy Rail Rifle
a36b399423b6.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target also suffers 1 mortal wound on top of any other damage.

a46b07678ca1.name: Riptide Shield Generator
a46b07678ca1.plain: This unit's RIPTIDE model gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

a4b6dad63d64.name: Ghostkeel Electrowarfare Suite
a4b6dad63d64.plain: As long as this unit's GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT model has wounds left, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every ranged attack that targets this unit.

a5c445f9fd90.name: Targeting Array (Hammerhead)
a5c445f9fd90.plain: Whenever this unit's HAMMERHEAD model is picked to shoot, you may re-roll a single hit roll while resolving its attacks.

a5f43d51bb7c.name: Tactical Acumen (Farsight)
a5f43d51bb7c.plain: In your Command phase, you may choose one FARSIGHT ENCLAVES CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this model. For the rest of the turn: that unit can still shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back; and for each ranged attack a CORE model in that unit makes, you can ignore any or all hit modifiers.

a6928e13d41a.name: Master of War
a6928e13d41a.plain: Once per battle, at the start of your turn, one <SEPT> COMMANDER unit in your army may declare Kauyon or Mont'ka. Kauyon: if one of your <SEPT> COMMANDER units declared Kauyon this turn, then when your Movement phase starts you may choose any number of your <SEPT> units within 6" of it. For the rest of the turn, the chosen units can't move for any reason, but each attack made by a model in them can re-roll its hit roll. Mont'ka: if one of your <SEPT> COMMANDER units declared Mont'ka this turn, then when your Movement phase starts you may choose any number of your <SEPT> units within 6" of it. For the rest of the turn, the chosen units can shoot as if they hadn't moved this turn. Unless a rule says otherwise, you can use the Master of War ability only once per battle, no matter how many models in your army have it.

a6b3bee5fd8e.name: Smart Missile Systems
a6b3bee5fd8e.plain: This weapon can target units the bearer can't see. Targets of attacks from this weapon don't get the benefits of Light Cover against those attacks.

a7d8a5f9c5dd.name: Enriched Reactors
a7d8a5f9c5dd.plain: When a model with this tenet shoots with a plasma weapon, each unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target, on top of any normal damage.

waive.130: page reference (pg 130) to where plasma weapons are printed; not part of the rule

aa1b87fb49bb.name: Twin Smart Missile System
aa1b87fb49bb.plain: This weapon can target units the bearer can't see. Targets of attacks with this weapon don't get the benefits of Light Cover against them.

aa84aa2f5601.name: Multi-sensory Discouragement Array
aa84aa2f5601.plain:
At the end of your Movement phase, roll 3D6 for one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer; if the total exceeds its Leadership, you choose a penalty for it. The penalty lasts until the start of your next Movement phase, and the options are:
- That unit loses the Objective Secured ability.
- Halve the Move characteristic of that unit's models, and halve its charge rolls.
- That unit's models can only make ranged attacks against the closest eligible target.

aaa171bdd935.name: Borthrod Gland
aaa171bdd935.plain: KROOT model only: in your Command phase, once per battle, the bearer can gain an aura that adds 1 to the Attacks and Strength of your nearby KROOT models. To do so it uses this Relic. The aura, Alien Glands, lasts until your next Command phase starts and covers the models in each of your KROOT units while that unit is within 6" of the bearer.

aacd1b24e1ae.name: Farsight Enclaves Tenet: Devastating Counterstrike
aacd1b24e1ae.plain:
Two effects:
- when a model with this tenet makes a ranged attack against a unit within 9", treat the target as having a Markerlight token.
- when a unit with this tenet is chosen to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one wound roll for its attacks.

waive.93: page reference (pg 93) to where Markerlight tokens are printed; not part of the rule

acceae756ae5.name: Master of War (Aura)
acceae756ae5.plain: Aura: re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by CORE models in any of your <SEPT> CORE units while that unit is within 6" of this unit's ENFORCER BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model.

acd14334df67.name: Hover Drone
acd14334df67.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 10, and it has the FLY keyword.

ad892f7bf7a3.name: Structural Analyser
ad892f7bf7a3.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your T'AU SEPT CORE units within 6" of this model, and one enemy unit this model can see. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the wound roll of each ranged attack a model in that T'AU SEPT CORE unit makes against that enemy unit.

ae096fe71f1c.name: Camouflage Fields (Shadowsun)
ae096fe71f1c.plain: As long as this unit's COMMANDER SHADOWSUN model has wounds left, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every ranged attack that targets this unit.

ae49dc31749c.name: Explodes
ae49dc31749c.plain: Roll one D6 when this unit's HAMMERHEAD model is destroyed, before you remove it from play. On a 6, it explodes, inflicting D6 mortal wounds on each unit within 6".

b1bbbb3e5cf0.name: Backup Ai
b1bbbb3e5cf0.plain: In your Command phase: choose one T'AU EMPIRE model in your army. Until your next Command phase starts, when working out which characteristics on its profile to use, treat it as having all of its wounds remaining.

b24fbc59d0e5.name: Multi-tracker
b24fbc59d0e5.plain: When the bearer makes a ranged attack against a unit that has 6 or more models, each unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit. Maximum 1 per model.

b2596714f70a.name: Armoured Aggression
b2596714f70a.plain: If you picked the Mont'ka Tactical Philosophy when the battle began, then once the first battle round starts (before any turn has begun), this unit may move up to 9" with a Normal Move. It can't finish that move within 9" of any enemy model.

b2adb61639da.name: Turbo-Jets
b2adb61639da.plain: Models with this tenet that can FLY have their Move characteristic increased by 2".

b2c50e20edac.name: Targeting Array (Sky Ray)
b2c50e20edac.plain: Whenever this unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model is picked to shoot, you may re-roll one hit roll while resolving its attacks.

b345f81ab88f.name: Explodes (6/3"/1)
b345f81ab88f.plain: Roll a D6 if this model is reduced to 0 wounds, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, and each unit within 3" takes a mortal wound.

b357d73e6a78.name: Ambushing Predators
b357d73e6a78.plain: When the first battle round starts, models in this unit may move up to 7" as a Normal Move. They must finish that move more than 9" away from all enemy models.

b51c2e13b710.name: 2. Sense of Stone
b51c2e13b710.plain: If this invocation is inspiring, pick one of your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units within 6" of this ETHEREAL: its CORE models can roll to avoid losing wounds. You can't pick a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES unit. Roll one D6 each time a CORE model in the chosen unit would lose a wound: on a 5+, that wound isn't lost.

b7146478ea30.name: Explodes
b7146478ea30.plain: Roll a D6 when this model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 9".

b8c7ac5d65ac.name: Drone Dock
b8c7ac5d65ac.plain: Any DRONE models in this unit start the battle docked with this unit's HAMMERHEAD model.

b98f0361ef8b.name: DW-02 Advanced Burst Cannon
b98f0361ef8b.plain: Models that have attacks from this weapon allocated to them can't use any rules that would let them ignore wounds they lose.

b9cad1cfef21.name: Dispersed Fusion Blaster
b9cad1cfef21.plain: If the target of an attack from this weapon is within half range, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 3.

ba4f802a76da.name: Automated Weapons
ba4f802a76da.plain: In your Shooting phase, whenever this model is picked to shoot and no friendly <SEPT> units are embarked within it, then for the rest of the phase it has a Ballistic Skill of 5+, and its attacks may only target one of these: the nearest eligible enemy unit, or the nearest eligible enemy VEHICLE unit.

ba856c841527.name: Explodes (6/9"/D6)
ba856c841527.plain: Roll a D6 if this model is reduced to 0 wounds, before it is removed from the battlefield. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 9".

ba85fb4b5f8b.name: Fire Caste Marksmen
ba85fb4b5f8b.plain: When a model with this tenet shoots with a pulse weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1.

waive.130: page reference (pg 130) to where pulse weapons are printed; not part of the rule

bac237b3bc5a.name: Rail Rifle
bac237b3bc5a.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target also suffers 1 mortal wound on top of any other damage.

bb93a7b4fc5e.name: Leadership Caste (Aun'va)
bb93a7b4fc5e.plain: You can add this unit to any T'AU EMPIRE Detachment other than a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES Detachment. Doing so doesn't stop that Detachment counting as a Sept Detachment, and doesn't stop your other units getting their Sept Tenet. This unit itself only gets a Sept Tenet if every <SEPT> unit in your army (ignoring SUPREME COMMANDER units) is from T'AU SEPT.

waive.55: page reference (pg 55) to where Sept Tenets are printed; not part of the rule

bbb446b8e36c.name: Vanguard
bbb446b8e36c.plain: When the first battle round starts, this model may move up to 7" as a Normal Move. It must finish that move more than 9" away from all enemy models.

bc8244435a07.name: Resonator Warheads
bc8244435a07.plain: If the bearer scores any hits with this weapon against an INFANTRY, BEAST or CAVALRY unit, halve the Move characteristic of models in that unit until the start of your next Shooting phase. If other modifiers also apply to their Move characteristic, this ability can't take it below half.

be2a55438650.name: Relentless Fusillade
be2a55438650.plain:
In your Shooting phase, when one of your STRIKE TEAM units is picked to shoot. Until the phase ends:
- Models in that unit firing pulse rifles make twice as many attacks, ignoring the usual Rapid Fire rules.
- Each ranged attack by a CORE model in that unit has its Armour Penetration improved by 1.

c08857c99558.name: 3. Nomadic Hunter (Aura)
c08857c99558.plain: Aura: your nearby KROOT units shoot as though they had Remained Stationary. While one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this WARLORD, unless it Fell Back this turn, it counts as having Remained Stationary in its previous Movement phase whenever its models make a ranged attack.

c0bede4b2cb0.name: High Intensity Markerlight
c0bede4b2cb0.plain: Markerlight: this weapon follows the Markerlight rules.

c1a29b05293d.name: Drone Controller
c1a29b05293d.plain: In your Command phase, you can give the DRONE models in one DRONE unit within 6" of the bearer Ballistic Skill 4+ until your next Command phase starts. Any GUN DRONE models in that unit also lose the Drone Identification Protocol ability for the same period.

c1bb6bc7e3e8.name: Master of War (Aura)
c1bb6bc7e3e8.plain: Aura: re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by CORE models in any of your <SEPT> CORE units while that unit is within 6" of this unit's CRISIS BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model.

c29524c91004.name: Tactical Disengagement
c29524c91004.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, if you picked the Kauyon Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle and the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rule, then if this unit is within 9" of any battlefield edge you can take it off the battlefield and put it into Strategic Reserves.

c357792c87a4.name: Pinpoint Targeting
c357792c87a4.plain: When a model with this tenet makes a ranged attack against a unit within 12", the target doesn't get the benefits of Light Cover against it.

c39492ce72f7.name: Experimental pulse submunitions rifle (EMP)
c39492ce72f7.plain: When an attack with this weapon targets a VEHICLE unit and the hit roll succeeds, the target suffers 3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

c4a3662a0187.name: Drone Dock (Tidewall)
c4a3662a0187.plain: Any DRONE models in this unit start the battle docked with this unit's TIDEWALL DRONEPORT model.

c4dc81c2572d.name: The Humble Stave
c4dc81c2572d.plain: The bearer adds 1 to rolls to see if its invocations are inspiring and, if on the battlefield in your Command phase, can intone one extra invocation it knows. That extra invocation must be one of the Invocations of the Ethereals that no friendly model has intoned this turn.

waive.76: page reference (pg 76) to where the Invocations of the Ethereals are printed; not part of the rule

c523d1427918.name: Nova Reactor
c523d1427918.plain:
In your Command phase, this unit's RIPTIDE model may activate its Nova Reactor. To do so, roll 2D6: if the total exceeds the RIPTIDE model's remaining wounds, the reactor burns out and this ability is unusable for the rest of the battle. Otherwise, pick one reactor ability:
- Nova Shield: until your next Command phase starts, roll a D6 whenever this model would lose a wound; on a 5+ that wound isn't lost.
- Boost: during your next Charge phase, this unit may make a Normal Move of up to 2D6"; if it does so, it can't declare a charge that phase.
- Nova Charge: until your next Command phase starts, if this model has a heavy burst cannon, that weapon is Type Heavy 16; if not, both profiles of its ion accelerator are Type Heavy 8 instead.

c6ee07bb709a.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
c6ee07bb709a.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS model with at least one T'au flamer can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

c71148d22960.name: Way of the Short Blade
c71148d22960.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, you can pick one of your FARSIGHT ENCLAVES CORE units within 6" of this model. Until the end of that phase, add 1 to the hit roll of each attack made by a CORE model in that unit.

c711d3675838.name: Set up Turret
c711d3675838.plain: If this unit includes a Support Turret, that model isn't set up until the unit performs this action. Deploy Turret (Action): BREACHER TEAM or STRIKE TEAM units from your army, in any number, can start this action in your Command phase. It completes at the end of your next Movement phase. When it does, if the unit has a Support Turret model that is neither on the battlefield nor destroyed, set that model up on the battlefield in Unit Coherency with its unit.

c790719c7f7e.name: Automated Armour Defences
c790719c7f7e.plain: COMMANDER model only: roll one D6 at the start of your Shooting phase to see whether the closest visible enemy unit suffers mortal wounds. On a 2-4, the closest enemy unit that is visible to the bearer and within 18" of it suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, the closest enemy unit that is visible to the bearer and within 12" of it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

c791068bda9c.name: Seeker Missile
