c791068bda9c.plain: The bearer can fire each of its seeker missiles only once per battle.

c8596110fdfa.name: Explodes (Manta)
c8596110fdfa.plain: Roll a D6 when this model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 4-5 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 2D6". On a 6 it explodes, dealing 2D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 3D6".

c93b2a7356df.name: Strength of Conviction
c93b2a7356df.plain: Roll one D6 whenever this WARLORD would lose a wound: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

c9d08972ae7d.name: Supersonic
c9d08972ae7d.plain: When this model Advances, Falls Back or makes a Normal Move, first turn it on the spot by up to 90 degrees (the turn doesn't count toward how far it moves), then move it straight ahead. It can't pivot again after that first pivot.

cba6006671e7.name: Flare Launcher
cba6006671e7.plain: Whenever the bearer would lose a wound because of a ranged attack with Strength 7 or more, roll one D6: on a 5+, the bearer doesn't lose that wound.

cc84fea2de4a.name: Explodes
cc84fea2de4a.plain: Roll a D6 when this unit's DEVILFISH model is destroyed, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 6".

cdaec5485e51.name: Drone Dock (Devilfish)
cdaec5485e51.plain: Any DRONE models in this unit start the game docked with this unit's DEVILFISH model.

cdbe028ab81c.name: Supreme Loyalty (Aura)
cdbe028ab81c.plain: Aura: your T'AU EMPIRE CORE units (except FARSIGHT ENCLAVES and T'AU AUXILIARY units) can borrow this unit's Leadership characteristic in place of their own while they are within 9" of this unit's ETHEREAL model.

ce19c5145d0d.name: Guardian Shield Generator
ce19c5145d0d.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. Whenever a ranged attack targets this unit, an unmodified wound roll of 1 or 2 for it always fails, regardless of any abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

cf45589444d4.name: Aerial Scanners
cf45589444d4.plain: Ranged attacks made by this unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model against an AIRCRAFT unit add 2 to their hit roll, and you can re-roll their damage roll.

d013fe9dc367.name: Evasion Manoeuvres
d013fe9dc367.plain: When a model with this tenet Advances, the FLY models in its unit get a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks until your next Movement phase starts.

d03a78369abb.name: Velocity Tracker
d03a78369abb.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of each ranged attack the bearer makes against a unit that can FLY. Maximum 1 per model.

d049afa7dd8e.name: Recon Suite
d049afa7dd8e.plain: When a model in this unit makes a ranged attack targeting a unit within 18", the target gets no benefit from Light Cover against it.

d0bdae94c95c.name: 5. Exemplar of the Kauyon
d0bdae94c95c.plain: After both armies deploy and the first turn is decided, redeploy up to one of your <SEPT> units, or up to three if you picked the Kauyon Tactical Philosophy. If the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rules, any of these units can go into Strategic Reserves at no extra CP cost, regardless of how many are there already. If both players have redeploy abilities, roll off: the winner decides which player deploys their units first.

waive.92: page reference (pg 92) to where the Tactical Philosophies are printed; not part of the rule

d0c136de19e4.name: Supersonic
d0c136de19e4.plain: When this unit's SUN SHARK BOMBER model Advances, Falls Back or makes a Normal Move, first turn it on the spot by up to 90 degrees (the turn doesn't count toward how far it moves), then move it straight ahead. It can't pivot again after that first pivot.

d111dd085766.name: Assassin
d111dd085766.plain: Attacks this model makes against a CHARACTER unit can re-roll both the hit roll and the wound roll.

d2056937a7d1.name: Breach and Clear
d2056937a7d1.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your BREACHER TEAM units is picked to shoot: for the rest of the phase, ranged attacks by CORE models in that unit ignore the benefits of cover, and you can re-roll their wound rolls.

d26185130e51.name: Marksman Stealth Field
d26185130e51.plain: A model can only pick this unit as a target for ranged attacks if this unit is the closest eligible target to it or is within 12" of it. If this unit doesn't Remain Stationary in your Movement phase, it loses this ability until your next Movement phase starts.

d350bcb43157.name: Wrecked (Tidewall)
d350bcb43157.plain: Roll a D6 when this Building is destroyed, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 6". On any other roll it is wrecked instead: it counts as destroyed for all rules purposes, but leave it on the battlefield. For the rest of the battle it is an Obstacle terrain feature with these terrain traits: Difficult Ground, Exposed Position and Unstable Position.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Rules"

d508081a8336.name: Kroot Pack
d508081a8336.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, then for every KROOT CARNIVORES unit in a Detachment, that Detachment can also include no more than one each of KROOTOX RIDERS, KROOT HOUNDS and KROOT SHAPER units without them taking up Battlefield Role slots.

d7e1f5522aa8.name: Vengeance
d7e1f5522aa8.plain: Re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever this model attacks an ASTRA MILITARUM unit.

d822faf487d0.name: Hot-blooded
d822faf487d0.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your VIOR'LA units is picked to shoot: until the phase ends, whenever a model in that unit (other than DRONE models) attacks the closest eligible target, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target on top of the normal damage, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

d87dd7bc239c.name: Explodes (Piranhas)
d87dd7bc239c.plain: Whenever a PIRAHNA model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing 1 mortal wound to each unit within 3".

d8dd93a05509.name: Volley Fire (Aura)
d8dd93a05509.plain: Aura: while one of your <SEPT> CORE units is within 6" of this unit's CADRE FIREBLADE model, each unmodified hit roll of 6 made by a CORE model in that unit when attacking with a pulse weapon scores 1 extra hit.

waive.130: page reference (pg 130) to where pulse weapons are defined; not part of the rule

d9472aeb5c3a.name: Mobile Defences
d9472aeb5c3a.plain:
Units in your army can do this action.
Mobile Defences (Action): one of your units embarked inside a TIDEWALL TRANSPORT may begin this action at the start of your Movement phase, even though units embarked within TRANSPORTS can't normally do actions. It finishes at the end of that phase. On a successful completion, that TIDEWALL TRANSPORT may make a Normal Move, treating it as having a Move characteristic of 8" and the FLY keyword.

daf341a14343.name: Fidelity
daf341a14343.plain: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made with this weapon scores 1 extra hit.

db131bc0fb73.name: Valued Sacrifice
db131bc0fb73.plain: If this unit includes models without the DRONE keyword, any of its DRONE models that are destroyed are ignored for Morale tests.

db89bf7a7ef3.name: Fail-safe Detonator
db89bf7a7ef3.plain: In any phase, when one of your BATTLESUIT models is destroyed: before it is removed from play, skip any rules that its destruction would trigger (such as Explodes). Instead, roll a D6 for each unit within 3" of the model; add 1 to each roll if the model's Wounds characteristic is 12 or more. On a 3-5, the unit being rolled for suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

dc32659eee74.name: Vectored Manoeuvring Thrusters
dc32659eee74.plain:
BATTLESUIT model only:
- The bearer's Move characteristic goes up by 2".
- Once per battle round, when the bearer is picked as a target of a charge while not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can make a Normal Move by using this Relic. If it does, it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend until the end of the phase. Your opponent can choose new targets for the charge.

dc4adfe6793b.name: Dal'yth Sept Tenet: Trading Partners
dc4adfe6793b.plain:
Two effects:
- INFANTRY units with this tenet get the benefits of Light Cover against ranged attacks from attackers not within Engagement Range of them.
- if you chose a Tactical Philosophy at the start of the battle, T'AU AUXILIARY units in the same Detachment as units with this tenet also benefit from your army's chosen Tactical Philosophy.

waive.92: page reference (pg 92) to where the Tactical Philosophies are printed; not part of the rule
waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a reference, which the style guide says to leave out

dd3e024204f4.name: Orbital Ion Beam
dd3e024204f4.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase: put two Ion Beam markers on the battlefield, anywhere within 12" of one another. When your next Command phase starts, trace an imaginary straight line from one marker to the other, and roll a D6 for each unit that line crosses (add 1 if that unit is a BUILDING). On a 2-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6+, it suffers 3 mortal wounds. Afterwards, remove both Ion Beam markers.

dd3f947c0a13.name: Nova Reactor (Y'vahra)
dd3f947c0a13.plain:
In your Command phase, you may activate this model's Nova Reactor. Doing so deals 1 mortal wound to this model; then choose one effect below. The chosen effect lasts until your next Command phase starts:
- It gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
- You may use the Nova profile of its weapons.
- Add 12" to its Move characteristic, and it can shoot in a turn in which it Falls Back.

ddc36787f3e9.name: Neuroweb System Jammer
ddc36787f3e9.plain: In your Shooting phase: choose an enemy unit that is within 18" of one of your NEUROWEB SYSTEM JAMMER units and visible to it, then roll a D6. On a 3+, models in that enemy unit subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack they make until the start of your next Shooting phase.

de865b829b79.name: Resolute Firebase
de865b829b79.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one <SEPT> CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this unit's ENFORCER BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model. That unit has the Objective Secured ability until your next Command phase starts.

def4284e8d54.name: Targeting Array
def4284e8d54.plain: Whenever this unit's HAMMERHEAD model is picked to shoot, you may re-roll a single hit roll while resolving its attacks.

e160607ad821.name: The Be'gel Hunter's Plate
e160607ad821.plain: The bearer adds 1 to its armour saving throws, and you roll one D6 each time it would lose a wound: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.

e22e0d616b6c.name: Positional Relay (Aura)
e22e0d616b6c.plain: Aura: while one of your <SEPT> INFANTRY units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit fights you may re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll while resolving its attacks.

e29610ca1472.name: Set-Up (Tidewall)
e29610ca1472.plain: You may place TIDEWALL terrain features within 3" of other friendly TIDEWALL terrain features.

e3912f653db5.name: Aggressive Tactics
e3912f653db5.plain: During your Command phase, you may choose one <SEPT> CRISIS CORE unit from your army within 9" of this unit's COLDSTAR BATTLESUIT COMMANDER model. For the rest of the turn, when this unit Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, models in this unit add 8" to their Move characteristic until that phase ends.

e3a94fbe55d8.name: Terrain Feature
e3a94fbe55d8.plain: Once set up, this unit's Tidewall Shieldline counts as a Building terrain feature.

e6305ab651fb.name: Starflare Ignition System
e6305ab651fb.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can use this Prototype System to deal D3 mortal wounds on a 2+ to each other unit within 3" of it, rolling one D6 per unit. It can do so when it starts or ends a move, or when it uses its High-altitude Manoeuvres ability (before it is removed from the battlefield). COLDSTAR COMMANDER model only.

e8eae66c8a4d.name: Alternating Fusion Blaster
e8eae66c8a4d.plain: A COMMANDER or CRISIS model with at least one fusion blaster can swap one of them for this Prototype System.

ecae63afaf01.name: Battlesuits
ecae63afaf01.plain:
Even while their unit is within Engagement Range of enemy units, BATTLESUIT models in this unit can shoot with ranged weapons, but only at enemy units they are themselves within Engagement Range of. In that situation, other friendly units being within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit doesn't stop them targeting it.
A BATTLESUIT model with more than one ranged weapon may still pick targets that aren't within Engagement Range of its unit, but those attacks are only made if, when you come to resolve them, every enemy unit within Engagement Range of its unit has been destroyed. In addition, if any enemy units are within Engagement Range of a BATTLESUIT model's unit, subtract 1 from the hit rolls for that model's Heavy weapon attacks.

ecf1942f0432.name: Automated Weapon
ecf1942f0432.plain: In your Shooting phase, whenever this model is picked to shoot and no friendly <SEPT> units are embarked within it, then for the rest of the phase it has a Ballistic Skill of 5+, and you can pick one of these as the target for its attacks: the nearest eligible enemy unit, or the nearest eligible enemy VEHICLE unit.

ee0ece281fa1.name: Ionised Shockfield
ee0ece281fa1.plain: In your Shooting phase, when an attack with an ion weapon by one of your <SEPT> models destroys a model in an enemy unit: until your next Shooting phase starts, that enemy unit ignores the aura abilities of other enemy units.

eea63c42a8d1.name: Drone Familiar Cluster
eea63c42a8d1.plain: When this model is picked to shoot, you may re-roll a single hit roll and a single wound roll while resolving its attacks.

ef1f8dbad20e.name: Internal Grenade Packs
ef1f8dbad20e.plain: Once per turn, when this model has finished moving in your Movement phase, you may roll one D6 for a unit it moved over: on a 2+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.

f03260737c6e.name: Explodes
f03260737c6e.plain:
Roll a D6 when this model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. On a 4-5 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 2D6". On a 6 it explodes, dealing 2D3 mortal wounds to every unit within 3D6".
Designer's note: before the battle, if this model has no base, both players must agree on its footprint as though it had one.

f086ba486058.name: Londaxi Tribalest
f086ba486058.plain: If an attack from this weapon is allocated to a Vehicle model, its Damage characteristic becomes 3.

f13656ea6568.name: Target Lock
f13656ea6568.plain: Targets of the bearer's ranged attacks don't get the benefit of Light Cover against those attacks.

f17f7521a26d.name: Saviour Protocols
f17f7521a26d.plain: In any phase, when a model in one of your <SEPT> units fails a saving throw: choose one friendly <SEPT> DRONE model that is within 3" of that unit, or within 6" of it if the unit has a model equipped with a drone controller. Destroy that DRONE model, and change the Damage characteristic of the attack to 0 instead.

f230aad1d06d.name: Nova Reactor
f230aad1d06d.plain:
In your Command phase, you may activate this model's Nova Reactor. Doing so deals 1 mortal wound to this model; then choose one effect below. The chosen effect lasts until your next Command phase starts:
- It gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
- You may use the Nova profile of its weapons.
- During each Fight phase, roll a D6 per enemy unit within 6" of it; on a 4+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

f39f01a0666c.name: Leadership Caste
f39f01a0666c.plain: You can add this model to any T'AU EMPIRE Detachment other than a FARSIGHT ENCLAVES Detachment. Doing so doesn't stop that Detachment counting as a Sept Detachment, and doesn't stop your other units getting their Sept Tenet. This model itself only gets a Sept Tenet if every <SEPT> unit in your army (ignoring SUPREME COMMANDER units) is from VIOR'LA.

f541d46d0988.name: Strategic Conqueror
f541d46d0988.plain: In your Command phase, pick a friendly SA'CEA unit within 9" of this WARLORD: it has the Objective Secured ability until the start of your next Command phase. If the unit already has that ability, each of its models counts as one additional model when working out control of an objective marker.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a reference, which the style guide says to leave out

f7ffe0788b02.name: The Shaper Commands (Aura)
f7ffe0788b02.plain: Aura: while one of your KROOT units is within 6" of this model, re-roll a hit roll of 1 whenever a model in that unit makes an attack.

f81981d0f68a.name: Drone Dock (Sky Ray)
f81981d0f68a.plain: At the start of the battle, every DRONE model in this unit is docked with the unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model.

f8d7f063d1d9.name: Thermoneutronic Projector (Melee)
f8d7f063d1d9.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets D6+2 extra attacks with this weapon.

f8f79599bd2e.name: Dominator Fragmentation Launcher
f8f79599bd2e.plain: Blast. This weapon can target units that aren't visible to the bearer. When the bearer shoots with it and scores at least one hit, models in the target unit have their Leadership characteristic reduced by 4 until the turn ends.

f9913872e30e.name: Outflank
f9913872e30e.plain: At the end of your Movement phase: choose a DAL'YTH CORE or T'AU AUXILIARY unit in your army that's within 9" of any battlefield edge. If the mission has the Strategic Reserves rule, you may move that unit from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

f9bb02bea7db.name: Hover (Manta)
f9bb02bea7db.plain: In your Command phase, this model may hover. If so, until your next Command phase starts, its Move characteristic is 20" and it loses its Airborne, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities.

f9cfdebda321.name: Explodes
f9cfdebda321.plain: Roll a D6 when this transport is destroyed, before any embarked models disembark and before it is removed from play. On a 6 it explodes, dealing D6 mortal wounds to every unit within 9".

fa8db67e3927.name: 6. Exemplar of the Mont'ka
fa8db67e3927.plain: In your Command phase, pick a friendly <SEPT> CORE unit within 9" of this WARLORD: its CORE models can re-roll ranged wound rolls against enemy units within 9". That range is 12" instead if you picked the Mont'ka Tactical Philosophy this battle. The effect lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

waive.92: page reference (pg 92) to where the Tactical Philosophies are printed; not part of the rule

fa9bae66c2d8.name: Targeting Array
fa9bae66c2d8.plain: Whenever this unit's SKY RAY GUNSHIP model is picked to shoot, you may re-roll one hit roll while resolving its attacks.

fd16b51adc0e.name: Combat Debarkation
fd16b51adc0e.plain:
At the start of your Movement phase, choose how many of your DEVILFISH models to pick:
- Up to three, if your Tactical Philosophy for the battle is Mont'ka and this is battle round 1, 2 or 3.
- Up to three, if your Tactical Philosophy for the battle is Kauyon and this is battle round 3, 4 or 5.
- Otherwise, one.
For the rest of the phase, each time a picked model finishes a Normal Move, units embarked within it may then disembark. Units that disembark like this can't charge this turn.

fdfd9764ce51.name: Seeker of Perfection
fdfd9764ce51.plain: This WARLORD's ranged attacks improve their Armour Penetration by 1, and each unmodified wound roll of 6 on them also deals 1 mortal wound to the target. These mortal wounds are on top of any normal damage, up to a maximum of 3 per phase.

fe585ff11070.name: Heavy Rail Cannon
fe585ff11070.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon wounds successfully, the target also suffers D3 mortal wounds on top of any other damage.

fe9e17c08d19.name: Emergency Dispensation
fe9e17c08d19.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the T'AU EMPIRE keyword: give one T'AU EMPIRE CHARACTER model in your army one Relic (one it is allowed to have). Every Relic in your army has to be different, and this Stratagem can't give a model a second Relic. You can use this Stratagem only once, except in a Strike Force battle (up to twice) or an Onslaught battle (up to three times).
